title: Self-host reconstruction spike + managed-bridge stand-up (ADR-0005)
summary: De-risk the reconstruction backend (ADR-0005, AUTH #018/#030): build the self-hosted Gaussian-splat pipeline — the committed, PRIORITIZED v1 path — and prove a captured room reconstructs and renders on a physical iPhone before committing the M1 pipeline. A managed bridge is CONDITIONAL: stand one up only under a written no-train + DPA + data-residency commitment (AUTH #030); otherwise skip it and rely on self-host. GPU long-running ops go to the Grok Operator; the pipeline code is the Builder's.
deliverables: services/reconstruction/ (self-host pipeline: COLMAP/GLOMAP + gsplat or Brush + Open3D)

acceptance_tests.test: The self-host pipeline produces a Gaussian splat (.ply/.spz) plus a derived collision mesh from a captured room, using only commercially-licensed components (gsplat/Splatfacto or Brush + COLMAP/GLOMAP + Open3D; INRIA 3DGS and SuGaR excluded). A report records the exact stack, licenses, and per-scan GPU time and cost.

The pruned/compressed splat renders on a physical iPhone in Unity 6 URP; splat count, package size, and frame rate are recorded against the <=150 MB package and 30 fps targets. Measurements are suggested evidence (SPEC 11), not a gate.

A managed reconstruction bridge is CONDITIONAL (self-host is primary, AUTH #030): stand one up for M1 validation only if a written no-train + DPA + data-residency commitment is on file — Autodesk APS Reality Capture (DPA + residency) OR KIRI Engine (written no-train + DPA + residency). Terms filed in legal/vendors/ before any real user scan (SECURITY_CHECKLIST 6.3); absent the terms, skip the bridge and rely on self-host.
A decision note recommends self-host vs the managed bridge for the M1 pipeline, with the iOS splat-render risk assessed; it feeds an ADR-0005 addendum if the direction firms up.

history.event: created by the Coordinator as the ADR-0005 reconstruction follow-up (AUTH #018, Owner chose 'spike + bridge').

AUTH #030 (Owner): self-host confirmed as the committed, prioritized v1 path — stand this spike up ASAP. Managed bridge is now conditional (only under written no-train + DPA + data-residency); AT-3 tightened; summary updated. Luma remains rejected.

Builder built the headless services/reconstruction/ scaffold (gsplat-first, pluggable SfM/trainer/compress/mesh adapters, cost+cap and commercial-license gates, 21 tests green, CUDA Dockerfile) and landed the cost+trainer analysis (research/vendors/reconstruction-cost-and-trainer-analysis.md); trainer recommendation = gsplat-first (pluggable, Brush second). Spike report skeleton created, render-path first (Owner decision). Status -> in-progress; the $100 GPU spike run (AUTH #031) is pending Unity/Mac/iPhone + input data.

Operator ran the Modal smoke test (AUTH #033): fixed the image build (Dockerfile CMD escape rejected by Modal's parser, plus splat-transform/Node 22, gsplat CUDA build, torchvision/numpy pins, headless Splatfacto via the colmap dataparser; commit 5a25f89). Mip-NeRF 360 room (public, 311 images_4) reconstructed end to end on an A10G: 311/311 registered, 431,684-Gaussian SPZ (8.0 MB) + Poisson OBJ collision mesh (36.3 MB), 44.3 MB package; pipeline 1371 s (SfM ~16 min on CPU, train ~6 min); $0.42 GPU-only per cost.json, $0.86 actual Modal metered incl. CPU/memory. Recorded in the spike report. AT-1 partly evidenced (public dataset, not yet a captured/corpus room); AT-2 (iOS render) and AT-4 (decision note) open, so status stays in-progress.

Operator: SfM speed-up. The image now has CUDA COLMAP 4.1.1 (conda-forge; GLOMAP built in as `colmap global_mapper`). Option A (GPU SIFT + GPU matching + incremental mapper) and option B (GLOMAP global mapper) were benchmarked on the same Mip-NeRF 360 room (311 images_4): an SfM-only matcher x mapper sweep plus 7 full runs with ns-eval quality. Winner and new modal_app.py default: A with `--matcher auto` (GPU exhaustive up to 500 images, sequential + loop detection beyond). SfM 16.2 -> 3.0 min, pipeline 22.9 -> 9.7 min, full cost $0.86 -> $0.26 per room, 311/311 registered, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 31.30/0.932/0.092 over 2 runs. B (`--sfm glomap`) stays selectable: equal registration, +48 s pipeline, +$0.02-0.03, -0.14 dB. The sequential matcher was fastest but gave one -1.2 dB run. cost.json now prices GPU + CPU + memory (cgroup meter; within ~3% of Modal's bill); CPU hard-limited to 8 cores; the Modal image is layered so code edits never rebuild; conda COLMAP SIGILL/OIIO pitfalls fixed. Spend $2.47 (credits; month about $3.6 of the $20 limit). Recorded in the spike report. Status stays in-progress (corpus room, AT-2 iOS render, AT-4 decision note open).
